decisions.reason: As an improved, renamed version of an already accepted trommel screen in a core category, it is very likely to remain in the portfolio.
The mobile flail shredder line fits the firm's core mobile recycling machinery business and would normally be kept to build installed base and service revenues.
This green-waste grinder remains relevant for composting and biomass customers, but its narrower positioning and overlap risk make it more vulnerable than the other surviving lines.
The stationary single-shaft pre-shredder line matches the firm's established shredding portfolio and is likely to stay as a complementary stationary offering.
